title: Sulfur & Cinnabar Retake
description: simple resource pack retexture sulfur and cinnabar.
body:
My new resource pack, retextur all sulfur and cinnabar blocks, making them more natural look.

Sulfur and cinnabar blocks now resemble mustard and ketchup.

The polished cinnabar came to resemble real polished cinnabar. red and toxic:)
